references.title: DWDS: allein
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; filed 'adverbiell'; the Etymologie labels it Adj. ('abgesondert, ganz für sich', nur prädikativ)

notes.rationale: nur daran, allein zu sein, to be alone: DWDS gives the entry no word class and files the sense 'adverbiell', and its etymology labels it Adj., so ADJ (ADR 0054). DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word. It is predicative only, so it has no paradigm and is indeclinable, with no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051), as every other indeclinable in the gold: the Root allein alone (#1241 round 9, settled by ADR 0051).
